rec.name: Payment Icons (selectable, sortable trust badges)
rec.status: Duplicate — already in Focal theme / covered by the PDP 'Raten-/Rechnungskauf' ticket; proposal to merge into one 'Sectionfy | Global | Payment Icons'

what.text: A standalone Shopify section named 'Payment Icons' that shows a row of accepted payment-method logos. The ticket scopes it to the cart drawer (cart layer) and the cart page. The screenshots show the same row directly under the primary CTA button. Merchants choose which icons appear, the colour style (monochrome or colourful) and the order of the icons.

why.text: Showing familiar payment logos near the purchase button lowers payment anxiety and signals that the shop is legitimate. It also confirms that the shopper's preferred method (PayPal, Klarna, Apple Pay and so on) is accepted, which removes a last-moment objection. The monochrome variant blends into minimalist brands, while the colourful variant uses brand-recognisable logos for faster recognition.

how.text: Build one section with a checkbox per payment method, a colour-scheme select (Variant 1: black/grey, Variant 2: colourful) and a way to reorder the icons. Render inline SVGs or icon assets in the chosen palette and place the section in the cart drawer and the cart page template. Shopify has no native drag-and-drop for checkboxes. Reordering therefore likely needs block-based icons (each icon is a sortable block) or an ordered list setting. Optionally add a heading such as 'We accept' above the row. A comment suggests making the section global, so the same instance can also be used on the PDP.

items: Checkboxes for the icons: PayPal, Klarna, Visa, MasterCard, Twint, Google Pay, Apple Pay, AMEX, Sofort, Amazon Pay
Colour scheme: Variant 1 black/grey (reference: thea3b.com), Variant 2 colourful (reference: hnds.de)
Custom icon order, editable by the merchant
Design variations selectable in the section: outlined monochrome icons with a 'We accept' heading (reference: sirplus.de) and colourful icons on white cards (reference: hnds.de)
Optional heading text (e.g. 'We accept'), as seen in the screenshot (I)

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields needed. Needs a payment-icon asset set (SVGs) in both monochrome and colour. The cart drawer must support sections or blocks. A comment says the Focal theme already has payment icons, and another says a similar block exists in 'CRO | Cart | Raten-/Rechnungskauf', so reuse and merge rather than rebuild. The team proposed one global section instead of separate PDP and Cart versions.

items: Conversion rate by payment method (e.g. Klarna and PayPal usage)

images.caption: Monochrome outlined variant: 'We accept' heading with a row of dark-green outlined icons (PayPal, Visa, Klarna, Apple Pay, Google Pay, another Pay icon, AMEX, Mastercard) under the add-to-cart button.
Colourful variant: brand-coloured icons (PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, AMEX, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort) on light cards under a black CTA button.
